title: Add Jar Shake Inertia Physics & Rainbow Wildcard Sphere
description: Allow tilting or shaking the jar using touch/drag inertia to dislodge trapped smaller spheres, and introduce a rare Rainbow Wildcard sphere every 15 merges that merges with any fruit.

title: Add Conveyor Splitter Gate & Dynamic Speed Surge
description: When combo chains reach 5 matching marbles, accelerate conveyor speed with golden particle trails and activate a lane splitter gate dividing marbles into dual collector tracks.

title: Add Shelf Restock Conveyor Drop & Golden Item Trio Multiplier
description: When a cabinet tier is fully cleared, trigger a soft wooden drawer restock drop from above, and spawn occasional glistening Golden Items that grant 3x Coins when matched.

title: Add Cluster Bomb Cannon Ammo & Slow-Mo Destruct Cam
description: When hitting a tower's foundational support block, trigger a brief 0.3s cinematic slow-mo zoom with trauma shake, and add a cluster bomb ammo type that splits into 3 mini-bombs mid-air.

title: Add Mega-Tornado Hazard & AI Bot Personality Taunts
description: Spawn a roving weather cyclone in the center of the arena during the final 30 seconds that spits swallowed props across the map, and display emoji chat bubbles over bots when they swallow or get swallowed.

title: Add Ricochet Bouncing Projectiles & Golem Frost Freeze
description: Cannonballs bounce up to 2 times off stone fortress walls before detonating, and ice loot cubes freeze advancing golems for 3 seconds.

title: Add Fake-Multiplayer Ghost Drones & Speed Boost Rings
description: Spawn 2-3 AI rival ghost drones with floating player name tags and add golden speed-boost rings between pillars that grant +3 bonus points and brief invulnerability dash.

title: Add Cascade Combo Fever Bar & 2x Score Surge
description: Add a decaying combo fever bar to the top HUD that fills when consecutive 10-tile cascades trigger within 4 seconds; when full, activate Fever Mode with golden particle trails and 2x quota progress.

title: Add Acrylic Plate Raycast Occlusion Feedback & Orbit Hint
description: Include active non-falling plates in tap raycasting so tapping a screw covered by a front plate flashes the obstructing plate in red and displays a subtle 360-orbit hand prompt.

title: Add Translucent Slide Destination Ghost Preview & Gate Pulse
description: When a player grabs a polyomino block, highlight matching color shredder gates with a subtle scale pulse to improve instant visual readability.

title: Add Rapid-Clear Streak Counter & Ascending Audio Pitch
description: Track consecutive valid arrow block clears without a blocked bonk; display a floating streak badge (2x, 3x, 4x...) and ramp Web Audio synth pitch per streak step.
